about: Kalshi prediction-market exchange: search public markets and read prices, volume, order books, trades, price history and close dates from Kalshi's public v1 API (no login needed).

commands.summary: Search or browse prediction markets (series/events with their markets, prices and volume) by keyword, category, status and frequency, sorted by relevance, trending, volume, newest or closing soon.

params.name: query
params.description: Keyword search text, e.g. bitcoin, fed, senate. Omit to browse everything.

params.name: order_by
params.description: Sort order: querymatch (relevance, use with query), trending, volume, event-volume, newest-event, price-delta (top movers), closing (closing soonest).

params.name: frequency
params.description: Comma-separated series frequencies: one_off, one_time, daily, weekly, monthly, quarterly, annual, custom.

params.name: category
params.description: Category filter, e.g. Economics, Elections, Crypto, Sports, Politics.

params.name: excluded_categories
params.description: Comma-separated categories to exclude, e.g. Sports.

params.name: cursor
params.description: Pagination cursor from the previous response's next_cursor.

commands.summary: Get an event and all its markets: title, rules, settlement sources, and per-market bid/ask/last price, volume, open interest, open/close/expiration dates and status. Comma-separate several event ticke

params.name: eventTicker
params.description: Event ticker(s), comma-separated, e.g. CONTROLH-2026 (the last path segment of a kalshi.com/markets/... URL, uppercased).

commands.summary: Get one market's current price (yes bid/ask/last in dollars), volume, open interest, status and open/close/expiration dates by market ticker.

params.name: marketTicker
params.description: Market ticker (event ticker + outcome suffix), e.g. CONTROLH-2026-D or KXBTCD-26OCT2117-T82749.99.

commands.summary: Compact card view of an event: series/event titles, total event and series volume, and each market's title, ticker, yes bid/ask, price, open and close dates.
Get the live order book (yes and no price levels with resting quantity, prices in dollars) for one or more markets.
List recent public trades in a series: market ticker, price, contract count, taker side and time.

params.name: seriesTicker
params.description: Series ticker (event ticker prefix before the first dash), e.g. CONTROLH, KXBTCD.

commands.summary: Chart history of an event's forecast (implied probability or implied value) over a time range at a chosen candle interval.
Price/probability history of a single market (by market UUID 'id' from get-event or get-market) over a time range.

params.name: marketId
params.description: Market UUID (the 'id' field of a market, not its ticker).

commands.summary: Get series metadata: title, category, frequency, tags, total series volume, fee type, settlement sources and contract rules URL. Comma-separate several tickers.
List series/events related to a given event ticker (recommendations), with their markets, prices and volume.

params.name: api_limit
params.description: Max related series. (sent to the site as "limit"; clify's own --limit only shapes the output)

commands.summary: Total dollar volume of a milestone (a group of related events, e.g. an election or Fed meeting) broken down per event; milestone_id comes from get-event-summary.
Live real-world data for milestones (e.g. election vote counts, reporting %, race call status, game scores) shown on the calendar.
List active perpetual/margin markets (crypto etc.) with bid, ask, price, 24h volume, open interest and leverage.
List topic keywords (tags) with how many events each covers; useful for discovering search terms.

params.name: api_limit
params.description: Keywords per page. (sent to the site as "limit"; clify's own --limit only shapes the output)

params.name: cursor
params.description: Pagination cursor from the previous response.

commands.summary: Check whether the Kalshi exchange and trading are currently active.
